content: simdutf8 0.1.5 (2024-09-22) is SIMD-accelerated UTF-8 validation ONLY - it does not do byte encoding/transcoding and is irrelevant to DNA 2-bit packing (input is ASCII ACGT). wide crate: current 1.7.1 MSRV 1.89 fails the 1.80 gate; 0.7.33 (2025-06-21) MSRV 1.61 passes and is pinnable as wide =0.7.33 for safe portable SIMD (SSE/NEON). Preferred: hand-rolled std::arch kernels for the small encode/canonicalize hot loops, zero new dependencies; wide 0.7.33 only if an unsafe-free implementation is required.
